caption:
Hotel says "Shinjuku"? Check which station first 🚉

🛍️ Shinjuku-sanchome: from about ¥15,000 on our sample night, direct subways to Shibuya, Ikebukuro and Ginza
🚄 JR Shinjuku: from about ¥22,000, but the first Narita Express leaves around 5:55
💴 Higashi-shinjuku: from about ¥13,000, but Fukutoshin Line express trains pass through

Our take: Sanchome most nights, JR Shinjuku only before an early airport train.

Under the East Exit there's a tiny café that has fed commuters since 1970, open from 7 a.m. ☕ Comment SHINJUKU 👇 (DMs with SHINJUKU work too)
